description: Phase B. olivine/pulling.ex and basalt/pulling.ex long-pull the Log directly; switch to Demux.pull(shard_id, start_after) which serves buffer (recent) or ObjectStorage chunks (historical). Gated on B1 (shallow logs).

comments.text: From q67.8 audit: (1) get_durable_version_fn is now dead plumbing in olivine+basalt pulling (stored, never called) — repurpose for Demux durable_up_to reporting or remove. (2) Known gap this ticket closes: a materializer lagging behind the Demux durable point gets :version_too_old from a shallow log with no Demux read path to fall back on — the trim machinery is live TODAY via ShardServer->Demux->log sends, so q67.10 is what makes aggressive trimming safe for slow materializers.

title: Materializer pull source: Log -> Demux
